description: This file implements a Kubernetes cloud provider controller for managing service load balancers, including creation, update, deletion, and node synchronization logic.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main controller struct managing load balancer services and node synchronization.

classes.name: cachedService
classes.description: Represents cached state of a service.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Controller instance with informers and queues.

methods.name: wantsLoadBalancer
methods.description: Checks if a service requests a load balancer and is not using a custom LoadBalancerClass.

methods.name: loadBalancerIPsAreEqual
methods.description: Compares LoadBalancerIP fields of two services.

methods.name: syncService
methods.description: Synchronizes a service's load balancer state based on its current configuration.

methods.name: syncNodes
methods.description: Updates load balancer backends to match current nodes.

methods.name: updateLoadBalancerHosts
methods.description: Updates all load balancers to match the latest node list, with retries.

methods.name: lockedUpdateLoadBalancerHosts
methods.description: Performs the actual update of load balancer hosts, with event recording.

methods.name: addFinalizer
methods.description: Adds a finalizer to a service for cleanup purposes.

methods.name: removeFinalizer
methods.description: Removes the load balancer cleanup finalizer from a service.

methods.name: patchStatus
methods.description: Updates the LoadBalancerStatus of a service.

methods.name: listWithPredicates
methods.description: Lists nodes matching all provided predicates.

methods.name: respectsPredicates
methods.description: Checks if a node satisfies all predicates.
